response.sql:
WITH team_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
), stats AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        total_games,
        total_games / SUM(total_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_all_games,
        total_games / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game) AS ratio_to_record_average
    FROM team_totals
)
SELECT team_id, total_games, fraction_of_all_games, ratio_to_record_average
FROM stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_record_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is over non-NULL games values across all home_game records, as standard AVG ignores NULLs; team totals likewise use SUM, which ignores NULLs.
